basis.all_native_DD: Seed plus every interval native pre/postBTC/postSOL sample; final prequote at end-exclusive included; two post-boundary settlement rows excluded.
basis.calendar: One post_quote_paired_close per source minute, except finalminute uses final prequote left-limit. UTC period assigned by source bar_open_ms. Internal period ends include their boundary callbacks; finalend excludes settlement. Min/max and within-period DD in calendar CSV use this paired-minute sampling, not allphase DD.
basis.elapsed_time: Minutes sampled at one paired sample per source minute. Threshold sampled DD uses sampled runningpeak, with separate allnative threshold entry counts.
basis.rolling: Exact 1,60,1440,10080,43200-minute changes of paired native equity. 43200 is30days, not variablecalendar month.
basis.exposure: Actual native position quantity times same completed-bar close, divided bynativepaired equity; native side2LONG side3SHORT. Gross/share/net-directional not beta-adjusted. No realizedPnL inference.
basis.OHLC: 67.54771031869252420136632742% is a separate conditional favorable-to-later-adverse bound. No samebar extremaordering or historicalpath assumption.
basis.unknown: Signedfunding, realized perasset PnL and detailed venue fidelity remain UNKNOWN; reportstatus NOT_FAITHFUL_DIAGNOSTIC and ranking_eligible false inherited.

checks.export_repair: Last unrecovered episode has an extra end_observation field; recovered directly from durable JSON top10. No second trace pass.

settlement_bridge.bridge_qualification: Cash/equity/fee arithmetic only. Residual labels the difference between final native marked U and actual boundary cash increment before terminalfee. Do not infer signedfunding or reconstruct PnL using rawOHLCprices; nativePnL mark normalization can differ from exportedOHLCprecision.

all_native_underwater_elapsed.basis: Union of first-underwater native observation to first native recovery intervals; hold-last-observed native HWM state between timestamps. Zero-duration callback excursions contribute zero elapsed time. Distinct from paired post-SOL sampled peak/time.
